summary.plain: A large, complex detector at DESY built around one of the two points on the HERA ring where electrons and protons collided, designed to catch and identify the particles produced.
summary.technical: General-purpose ep collider detector at HERA, combining high-precision tracking, calorimetry and muon systems to reconstruct deep inelastic scattering events; exact subsystem specifications were not sourced in this session.

technology.quote: The H1 Detector is a very complex apparatus designed to detect particles which are created when high energy electrons and protons collide. Technologies used to build such a detector range from high precision mechanical engineering to modern electronics and up to date computing.
technology.value: Complex general-purpose detector combining high-precision mechanical tracking, calorimetry and modern electronics/computing to detect particles from ep collisions
